title: 8.4 Proportionality Theorems

icans: I can use a segment parallel to one side of a triangle to find a missing length.
I can decide whether a segment is parallel to a side of a triangle.
I can use parallel lines and angle bisectors to find missing lengths.

vocab: a line ___________ to one side of a triangle that crosses the other two sides divides them proportionally
if a line divides two sides of a triangle _________________, it is parallel to the third side
a line that __________ two or more lines
a ray that divides an angle into two ____________ angles
